items.title: Human: Resume Writing
items.description:
• Hours spent perfecting wording and formatting
• Easy to miss typos or sound generic
• Adds unique personal stories and experiences

items.title: AI: Resume Writing
items.description:
• Generates tailored drafts in seconds
• Optimizes for keywords, ensures consistent format
• Can lack unique voice, sometimes generic phrases

items.title: Human: Translating Text
items.description:
• Requires deep language knowledge, can be slow
• May miss subtle cultural nuances or idioms
• Understands context, emotion, and local slang

items.title: AI: Translating Text
items.description:
• Instant translation for any volume of text
• Consistent terminology across large documents
• Struggles with humor, idioms, and deep context

items.title: Human: Speech Writing
items.description:
• Brainstorming, drafting, editing takes hours of effort.
• Writer's block, repetitive ideas, inconsistent tone.
• Deep emotional connection, personal stories, real charisma.

items.title: AI: Speech Writing
items.description:
• Generates full speech drafts quickly with good structure.
• Breaks writer's block, offers diverse stylistic options.
• Lacks genuine emotion, personal touch, can hallucinate

items.title: Human: Negotiation Pre
items.description:
• Researching parties, positions, goals is time-consuming.
• Missing key info, emotional bias, poor strategy planning.
• Reads body language, adapts strategy in real-time context.

items.title: AI: Negotiation Prep
items.description:
• Summarizes data, suggests talking points & scenarios fast.
• Processes vast amounts of data quickly, identifies patterns.
• No real-time social cues, cannot build rapport or trust.

items.title: Human: Scheduling Tasks
items.description:
• Manual entry is slow; easy to overlook details.
• Overlapping appointments; missed follow-ups occur.
• Understands subtle social cues; adapts to mood.

items.title: AI: Scheduling Tasks
items.description:
• Instantly finds optimal slots; avoids conflicts.
• Integrates multiple calendars; sends reminders.
• Can't handle last-minute human mood changes.

items.title: Human: Homework Help
items.description:
• Parents spend hours explaining complex concepts.
• Personal biases; limited knowledge in some areas.
• Offers emotional support; builds critical thinking.

items.title: AI: Homework Help
items.description:
• Provides instant explanations; step-by-step solutions.
• Available 24/7; covers vast subjects instantly.
• Can 'hallucinate' wrong answers; no true understanding.

items.title: Human: Shopping Compar
items.description:
• Hours spent researching, opening many tabs.
• Overwhelmed by choices, missing deals, decision fatigue.
• Can feel textures, try on clothes, trust intuition.

items.title: AI: Shopping Compariso
items.description:
• Instantly finds product details, prices, reviews.
• Processes vast data, identifies patterns quickly.
• Lacks real-time pricing, can't feel product quality.

items.title: Human: Story Writing
items.description:
• Takes days/weeks for plot, characters, emotions.
• Writer's block, inconsistent tone, character development.
• Deep personal experience, unique voice, raw emotion.

items.title: AI: Story Writing
items.description:
• Generates plots, characters, dialogue in seconds.
• Overcomes writer's block, ensures structural consistency.
• Often generic, lacks true originality or human depth.

items.title: Human: Legal Research
items.description:
• Hours spent sifting through dense legal texts.
• Missing key precedents; interpretation errors.
• Nuanced interpretation of complex case facts.

items.title: AI: Legal Research
items.description:
• Instantly scans vast databases for relevant cases.
• Rapidly identifies patterns and relevant statutes.
• Cannot provide legal advice; risks factual 'hallucinations'.

• Inconsistent design, information overload, writer's block.
• Deep understanding of audience emotion & flow.

items.description:
• Generates slide outlines & content in minutes.
• Creates consistent, structured starting points.
• Lacks emotional intelligence; generic visuals; no real

items.title: Human: Writing Essays
items.description:
• Takes hours of research, outlining, and drafting.
• Writer's block, accidental plagiarism, inconsistent flow.

items.description:
• Generates full drafts or sections in seconds.
• Excellent for quick outlines, grammar, and idea generation.
• Can hallucinate facts, lacks true originality or emotion.

items.title: Human: Music Discovery
items.description:
• Friends' tips, radio, live shows, deep dives on blogs.
• Slow, limited to your social bubble, often hit-or-miss.
• Finds niche gems, emotional connection, genuine serendipity.

items.title: AI: Music Discovery
items.description:

items.title: Human: Interior Design
items.description:
• Spend weeks browsing, measuring, second-guessing.
• Struggle to visualize, fear clashing colors/styles.
• Understand personal style, feeling, and flow intuitively.

items.title: AI: Interior Design
items.description:
• Generates concepts/layouts in seconds from photos.
• Offers endless variations, instant style exploration.
• Lacks true empathy, struggles with unique personal taste.

items.title: Human: Fitness Coaching
items.description:
• Requires consistent effort, often hit plateaus alone.
• Easy to lose motivation, risk injury with poor form.
• Provides emotional support, real-time form correction.

items.title: AI: Fitness Coaching
items.description:
• Creates custom plans fast, tracks progress diligently.
• Offers data-driven insights, 24/7 access to guidance.
• Can't see your form, lacks human empathy/motivation.
